now.title: VisionQuest
now.text: In episode 2, Now a pickpocket named Thomas Shepherd, he is captured by Paladin after claiming to be Vision's son.

proposed.text: In episode 1, Now a pickpocket named Thomas Shepherd, he is captured by Paladin after claiming to be Vision's son.

changes.evidence: VisionQuest episode 1 'No Strings': Paladin captures Thomas Shepherd, a grifter who claims to be Vision's son Tommy Maximoff. Episode 2 is the flashback to his drowning and Vision's rescue.

proposed.title: VisionQuest
proposed.text: In episode 6, Paladin, who took Tommy from Ultron, uses him as bait in Madripoor, but Tommy escapes with Lisa and uses his powers to save her from Jocasta's nanobot.

changes.evidence: Episode 5 'Firewall': recordings show Ultron letting Paladin kidnap Tommy. Episode 6 'Deadlock': Paladin brings Tommy to Madripoor to blackmail Vision; Tommy and Lisa hijack Paladin's van, and Tommy deactivates the nanobot Jocasta put in Lisa. Capture and escape have no record.

proposed.title: VisionQuest
proposed.text: In episode 5, Vision retakes his body by lowering his firewall, which lets Ultron escape, then heads to Madripoor with Lisa and rescues Tommy from Paladin.

changes.evidence: Episode 5 'Firewall': Vision lowers the firewall to regain control of his body while Ultron escapes the Mindspace; he wakes with Lisa on a plane to Madripoor. Episode 6 'Deadlock': he, Tommy and Lisa escape Paladin and the Ten Rings. The file ends with Vision 'Imprisoned' in his Mindspace with no record of his release.

now.title: Hawkeye
now.text: As Yelena moves in to finish Clint on the ice, he whistles the tune she shared with Natasha, and she breaks down.
cases: ST-089 The Battle at Rockefeller Center (Hawkeye)

changes.evidence: The whistle moment is part of Clint and Yelena's fight in Hawkeye episode 6 (Christmas 2024), which comes after the Black Widow post-credits scene at Natasha's grave where Valentina sends Yelena after Clint. Record k1 sits before k2, so it should move after k2 (next to k3, the same scene).

now.title: Loki S1
now.text: In episode 4, The TVA arrests the 2012 Loki and prunes branching timelines, and its agents turn out to be variants with wiped memories.

proposed.text: The TVA arrests the 2012 Loki and prunes branching timelines, and its agents turn out to be variants with wiped memories.

changes.evidence: The 'In episode 4' tag covers the whole record, but the TVA arrests the 2012 Loki in episode 1 ('Glorious Purpose'). Only the reveal that its agents are variants comes in episode 4 ('The Nexus Event', via C-20). Dropping the episode tag makes the record accurate for the season.

now.title: Ironheart
now.text: In episode 5, Xavier reconnects with Riri, demands she delete the Natalie AI, then makes peace with her.

proposed.text: Xavier reconnects with Riri, demands she delete the Natalie AI, then makes peace with her.

changes.evidence: Riri reconnects with Xavier in episode 1. He is horrified by N.A.T.A.L.I.E. and demands she delete it in episode 4. Only the reconciliation is in episode 5. The 'In episode 5' tag is wrong for most of the record, so dropping it fits the whole series.
